verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms Reclaim hosts a live MCP endpoint (mcp.reclaim.ai) implementing the OAuth protected-resource flow with read/write/mcp scopes, tied to the AI Assistant's 'MCP connectors' feature — direct evidence of a tool-calling surface. However, no first-party documentation enumerates the specific tools/resources exposed (availability, bookings, event types) or confirms scope of exposed calendar data, and there's no independent hands-on report of using it. Missing for 10: published MCP server docs listing exact exposed tools/resources, independent third-party validation of the endpoint's functionality, and confirmation event types/bookings are queryable via the surface.
